# Toolifia — Free Online AI Tools & Utilities
> 300+ free browser-based AI tools, developer utilities, SEO checkers, calculators, and converters. No account required.

## Main Tools
- AI Video Generator (Kling 2.1): https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/ai-video-generator
- AI Text Humanizer (Bypass AI detection): https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/ai-humanizer
- AI Content Detector (GPTZero compatible): https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/ai-detector
- JSON-LD Schema Markup Generator: https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/schema-generator
- SEO Meta Tag Generator: https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/meta-tag-generator
- JSON Formatter & Validator: https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/json-formatter
- Word & Character Counter: https://toolifia.vercel.app/tool/word-counter

## Platform Features
- 100% Free to use
- Runs directly in browser (client-side execution)
- No user sign-up or registration required
- Programmatic REST API endpoints available for developers
